messages:
rachel_sales: Quick heads-up — Orchid wants a 3-week POC. Needs a billing project, $4k hard spend cap, 21 days of trial credits, scoped expiring API keys, and optional Dedicated GPUs + VPC peering if latency is okay. Can we set this up with minimal friction?

ben_se: Standard approach ok. Steps: create billing org+project, attach spendshield, grant promo credits, issue ephemeral project-scoped keys (ttl 21d). Dedicated/GPU and VPC require infra ticket.

tara_finops: We can grant 21 days promo credits up to $2.5k and attach a $4k spendshield. Notes: promo credits are consumed first; spendshield will stop traffic at $4k. For credits >$1k I need a manager sign-off. Do we want auto-billing after cap?

rachel_sales: Sales will not auto-bill for trial. We'll cover $2.5k promo credits. No payment method needed for the trial.

mina_infra: For Dedicated: need expected req/s, average tokens per request, model family, and region. For VPC peering we need CIDR and peering contact. We can provide temporary "dedicated-burst" for 3 weeks if capacity allows.

ben_se: Orchid estimates 80 req/s, ~2k tokens/sec aggregate, open-weights family, prefers us-east-1. VPC initially optional.

alex_support: Sample ephemeral key snippet for them to use (21d ttl):

```
# create ephemeral key
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/ephemeral \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"project_id":"proj-orchid-poc","ttl_seconds":1814400,"scopes":["inference:generate"],"notes":"Orchid POC 21d"}'

# basic call
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"open-t5-medium","input":"test"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

alex_support: Reminder: ephemeral keys can't change billing settings. If Orchid needs multiple dev keys we can create per-engineer project keys limited to inference. Rotate mid-POC.

ops-bot: infra/9987: "Orchid POC - dedicated burst + optional VPC" created and assigned to mina_infra. ETA 48h for feasibility. finance/3344: "Orchid promo credits $2500 + spendshield $4000" queued for approval.

mina_infra: I can check capacity in us-east-1 and confirm within 24-48h. If peering is required, ask Orchid to fill the small network form and provide target CIDR.

tara_finops: I'll start the approval flow for $2.5k credits. Need legal name and billing contact email to create billing org.

rachel_sales: I'll share contact: liam@orchid.ai and Orchid AI, Inc. Action items: Mina to confirm infra; Tara to approve credits; Alex/Ben to issue ephemeral key and quickstart; I'll update customer and target start next Tuesday. Thanks! :pray:
